summary.one_liner: An awesome-style curated list of books, courses, videos, articles, talks, sample projects and pytest plugins for the pytest Python testing framework.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link collection rather than a software project. It is organized into sections: Books, Courses, Videos, Articles, Presentations, Code samples and projects, and Plugins. Most entries are a title with a short description and no URLs appear in the README text provided. The Plugins section is the largest, listing pytest plugins by category-like descriptions such as fake file systems, SQL query testing, multiple failures per test, test ordering, coverage, snapshot testing, and test selection based on code changes. It also points to a PyPI-based plugin list that the README says contains 865 plugins. The README states that recently published plugins are not accepted and that self-promotional or AI-generated content is not accepted.
use_cases: learning pytest from books and courses
discovering pytest plugins for a specific need
finding talks and presentations on pytest
looking up pytest plugins for mocking, coverage or parallel runs
comparing pytest snapshot or soft-assert plugins
notable: Large curated plugin section with over 800 pytest plugins referenced via a PyPI-driven list
Covers books, courses, videos, articles and talks in one place
Includes entries on pytest with uv, pytest-xdist parallel runs and pytest-ranking
Explicit contribution policy against recently published plugins and AI-generated promotional content
caveats: Link list only; no installable code or tool of its own
Plugin list is delegated to an external PyPI listing and may change over time
Entries carry short descriptions only, and no URLs appear in the README text provided
